variants.prompt: REFORM SCENE/SETTING: In a dimly lit, velvet-draped boudoir, the striking young woman lounges on a plush four-poster bed, the black leather jacket discarded, revealing her bare shoulders and a lacy white bra peeking from the open blouse. A single candle flickers nearby, casting dancing shadows on the walls as she gazes at the camera with a sultry, inviting smile, her emerald eyes sparkling with mischief.
